title: The Lord's arm awakens and remembers the redemption
description: The prophet calls on the Lord's arm to awake as in days of old, remembering how He cut Rahab in pieces, pierced the dragon, and dried up the sea so that the redeemed could cross over. This leads to the promise that those whom the Lord has ransomed will return to Zion with joy and everlasting gladness, while sorrow and sighing flee away [ref:Jes 51:9-11|Isaiah 51:9-11].
